project.name: Hummingbird namespace migration and model routing
project.description: Review-only sequential APEX curriculum: staged legacy namespace migration, immutable history/session compatibility, specialised coding handoffs and measured llama-server/Ollama admission on a 16 GB GPU. See docs/HUMMINGBIRD_NAMESPACE_MIGRATION.md. Registration authorises no implementation or background execution.

execution_policy.history_and_active_sessions: Preserve existing records and token bytes; retain validation until original expiry.

command_catalog.C01: Read-only root, revision, dirty-tree and whitespace baseline; exact commands in Markdown section 4.
command_catalog.C02: Read-only tracked namespace/path inventory using RX-01, RX-02 and RX-05.
command_catalog.C03: Read-only cookies, setting keys, imports, package IDs and contract inventory using RX-03/RX-04.
command_catalog.C04: Read-only selected-device VRAM, host MemAvailable, service health/models, installed help/version; no generation or model load.
command_catalog.C06: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_apex_external_server.py tests/test_chat_continuity.py tests/test_model_runtime_gateway.py tests/test_ollama_model_guard.py tests/test_seven_direct_runtime.py
command_catalog.C10: Read-only actual Studio schemas; verify configured paths before observed defaults.
command_catalog.C11: Read-only git diff --check, diff --stat, status --short plus bounded per-file get_diff.
command_catalog.C12: Read-only scoped UI brand scan; classify hits, never globally replace.

steps.title: HB-01 Verify Studio evidence retrieval and release gates
steps.description: Use the existing Studio-first curriculum and real dispatcher to retrieve evidence 95 for project P-26C093E7E6. If missing, propose/implement the bounded evidence lookup only with approval. Inspect scheduler on-hold/dependency enforcement before enabling pickup. No repeated transcript paging or instructor-access impersonation.
acceptance: Exact source verification IDs and lookup receipts independently match stored evidence.
Fresh-turn and unseen negative cases pass; wrong-scope, denied, absent, malformed and long-context tests pass.
Operator/task/approval gates proven; project hold alone is not assumed sufficient.
steps.rollback: Keep project on hold and all tasks blocked; disable any newly approved lookup through its reviewed rollback without deleting evidence.

steps.title: HB-02 Inventory and classify legacy namespace consumers
steps.description: Run C01-C03. Produce path/line/class/target/consumer/compatibility/owner/test ledger for branding, agent IDs, framework modules, config, cookies, persistence, services, platform IDs, history and third parties. Preserve dirty changes. Use exact regex catalogue as classifiers, not replacements.
acceptance: All proposed edit surfaces have exact source locations and dependent consumers.
Historical/third-party/credential/runtime exclusions explicit; counts distinguished from occurrences.
steps.rollback: No application mutation; retain inventory evidence and correct classifications rather than editing sources.

steps.title: HB-03 Verify backup restoration and per-slice rollback
steps.description: Propose approved online SQLite backups for configured primary/evidence stores, retention and protected baseline of existing uncommitted changes. Test restore on disposable storage. Define flag-off rollback per namespace/routing slice; never copy live DB/WAL as a guaranteed consistent backup.
acceptance: Operator-approved backup paths/retention and actual isolated restore receipt.
Production historical rows and session state unchanged; current edits accounted for.
steps.rollback: Keep implementation blocked until restoration is demonstrated; do not restore over a live database.

steps.title: HB-04 Approve canonical identities and compatibility map
steps.description: Specify canonical apex agent, hummingbird product modules, HUMMINGBIRD_* owned settings and hummingbird_session cookie. Known seven agent aliases resolve apex; classify fridays identities before mapping. Define new/old-key conflict rejection and same-principal ACL behaviour. Do not rewrite history.
acceptance: Operator-reviewed map per consumer and exact new name.
No privilege inheritance, unknown alias acceptance or destructive historical replacement.
Legacy TTL and existing signed/opaque tokens preserved.
steps.rollback: Retain old readers/writers until the reviewed mapping and tests are accepted.

steps.title: HB-05 Benchmark approved orchestrator and coding models
steps.description: Inspect actual registered artifacts and existing local candidates before downloads. Benchmark small generalists for orchestration and Qwen2.5-Coder 7B for patch tasks via approved llama-server profiles. Verify license/hash/quant/template/tool schema. Mistral/DeepSeek alternatives require equivalent evidence.
acceptance: Exact model profiles and held-out reliability/latency results.
Peak selected-device VRAM and host RAM measured at proposed context, batch and concurrency.
Operator selects models; no model-size marketing claim substitutes for fit.
steps.rollback: Restore original approved serving profile; no unapproved model download or overlapping resident load.

steps.title: HB-06 Implement approved cross-backend resource admission
steps.description: After approval, implement one host GPU coding lease covering llama-server and Ollama. Enforce measured incremental weight/KV/scratch budgets, initial proposed 2 GiB GPU and 8 GiB RAM reserves, one coding slot, stale-telemetry denial, explicit CPU/partial-offload profiles and externally owned service drain rules. Thresholds require measured approval.
acceptance: No admission with unknown memory or reserve breach.
Concurrency, cancellation, crash recovery and no-swap pressure tests.
No killing/adopting external APEX service or aggregate-other-GPU budget trick.
steps.rollback: Disable admission feature and retain old route; release only owned verified resources.

steps.title: HB-07 Add gated task-specialist routing and handoff contracts
steps.description: APEX stays canonical orchestrator/state manager; coder role generates refactoring proposals through llama-server. Add feature-flagged host classifier/registry routing, bounded request/result schemas and provenance. Eligible primary failure permits one admitted Ollama fallback; permissions, malformed output and failed tests never trigger bypass.
acceptance: Flag-off original route unchanged; flag-on task identity/context/receipt persistence passes.
Same ACL and approvals at both providers; exact model/backend/digest recorded.
Unknown fields/stale source/denial/output-budget failure remain explicit.
steps.rollback: Disable routing flag; checkpoint task and resume original orchestrator without rewriting its history.

steps.title: HB-08 Canary specialist delegation and bounded fallback
steps.description: Under approved server ownership transition, test checkpoint/drain/admit/infer/verify/release/resume. Prefer CPU-resident small orchestrator or checkpoint/unload; do not assume two GPU models fit. Test primary coder and eligible CPU/offloaded Ollama fallback without duplicate model copies.
acceptance: Specialist authors a small proposed patch; no unapproved apply.
Fresh-turn continuity and resource/latency/failed-test acceptance observed.
One bounded fallback, clear provenance and no OOM or foreign-process termination.
steps.rollback: Drain owned canary, retain Studio receipts and restore original server configuration after operator approval.

steps.title: HB-09 Add canonical identity and configuration readers
steps.description: Implement approved boundary alias normalisation and one owned-config resolver before writer changes. Legacy seven requests map apex only after caller authentication; new HUMMINGBIRD_* keys and old aliases conflict explicitly when unequal. Preserve third-party OLLAMA_*/LLAMA_ARG_* variables.
acceptance: Old/new alias/config fixtures resolve same effective principal without extra rights.
Unknown/spoofed identities denied; equal/unequal setting precedence tested.
No historical row/session rewrite.
steps.rollback: Disable canonical readers only while old writers remain; keep alias evidence and operator-approved compatibility.

steps.title: HB-10 Migrate cookie issuance and all authentication consumers
steps.description: Coordinate login_bp, services/auth, chat approval, SSE and Flask UI sessions. New login cookie name hummingbird_session; legacy friday_session validates to original expiry. Keep random token bytes/keys/TTL; share selected validated token for owner and approval binding. Reject conflicting principals and invalid canonical-cookie downgrade. Logout revokes presented valid credentials and clears both names.
acceptance: Old/new/expired/revoked/conflicting-cookie and logout tests.
Live old session remains valid and new login canonical, no active session mutation.
Same owner session binds chat, SSE and pending approval before/after cutover.
steps.rollback: Return to old issuance while preserving both validators; do not revoke or extend existing tokens as rollback.

steps.title: HB-11 Canonicalise future writes and primary agent grants
steps.description: Update active primary-agent defaults, routing and tool grants to apex, product metadata to hummingbird. Old database read projections resolve known aliases while preserving stored authors, project/snapshot IDs and active thread state. No duplicate canonical profile with divergent grants.
acceptance: New task/message/receipt/ACL fixtures canonical.
Old rows still readable with original provenance and unchanged scope.
Pending approvals and snapshot associations survive identity mapping.
steps.rollback: Disable canonical writer feature only via reviewed adapter; never mass-rewrite rows written during canary.

steps.title: HB-12 Migrate rendered product and primary agent branding
steps.description: Coder changes classified web/mobile/desktop titles, labels, accessible names, help/login text, notifications and localisation to Hummingbird/APEX. Leave historical chat messages and third-party names untouched. Review current dirty UI edits before proposing each patch.
acceptance: Rendered page title/login/nav/agent labels canonical.
Accessibility/browser smoke and localisation evidence.
Historical quotations, URLs and dependency assets preserved.
steps.rollback: Revert only approved UI slice through reviewed diff; retain unrelated UI edits.

steps.title: HB-13 Migrate Python modules with compatibility shims
steps.description: Move first-party framework implementations toward hummingbird and primary agent implementation toward agents.apex in reviewed slices. Legacy fridays/agents.seven/core.seven_llm/core.seven_runtime readers delegate to canonical implementations. Share singleton registries, dispatcher and locks; no dual state.
acceptance: Old and new import paths work, no cycles.
One registry/lock/server owner and unchanged permission behaviour.
All impacted focused tests and exact dependency-path checks pass.
steps.rollback: Keep tested old import shims and restore canonical slice only from reviewed changes.

steps.title: HB-14 Stage service CLI path and settings cutover
steps.description: Add Hummingbird commands/units/config and update first-party launchers. Preserve actual existing database/state resolution; never create a new empty store because a filename changed. Share mixed-version locks, avoid duplicate services on one port and approve each service restart.
acceptance: Dry-run deployment/config/entrypoint tests.
Old aliases work; same data selected; no double load or separate legacy/canonical locks.
Operator-approved canary restart and rollback receipt.
steps.rollback: Restore approved old unit/config route without touching DB contents or killing unrelated processes.

steps.title: HB-15 Approve and migrate distribution and platform contracts
steps.description: Separately approve exact Python distribution name, Android namespace/applicationId, desktop/iOS bundle IDs and Windows package paths. Determine reverse-domain ownership, signing continuity and old-install data upgrade strategy. No guessed publisher namespace or assumption that applicationId change is in-place upgrade.
acceptance: Exact operator-approved package IDs/signing and platform build commands discovered.
Old-installed-client upgrade/data-preservation tests on isolated devices.
Missing platform/signing capability is blocked, not counted as passed.
steps.rollback: Retain installed old IDs as explicit compatibility contracts until upgrade can be validated.

steps.title: HB-16 Update active docs CI tooling and discovery links
steps.description: Update classified active first-party docs, examples, workflows, skills and generated artifact labels to canonical paths. Preserve history, third-party/model names and published legacy URLs or redirect with explicit approval. Update links when skill folders move; no unrelated dependency changes.
acceptance: Active links/import/build references resolve.
Remaining legacy matches individually classified.
No historical evidence rewritten and no dependency vendor names changed.
steps.rollback: Restore only reviewed doc/tooling slice; retain old URL/import redirects as needed.

steps.title: HB-17 Run full compatibility routing and preservation matrix
steps.description: Execute all task-specific new tests plus relevant baselines in isolated fixtures, then approved browser canary. Cover both config namespaces/cookies/imports, old history/new writes, immutable sessions, same-principal ACLs, admitted primary/fallback coding handoffs and installed-client contracts.
acceptance: Exact commands/outputs/exit and resource/model/approval receipts saved.
All required measurable assertions pass; new tests do not read production credentials/storage.
First failed required assertion blocks rollout; selected tests not labelled full-suite.
steps.rollback: Keep feature flags off and fix bounded failures via approved specialist tasks.

steps.title: HB-18 Perform operator-controlled canonical cutover
steps.description: Activate canonical writers/routes/service entrypoints only in reviewed order with operator approvals. Monitor resource admission, auth/approval/SSE consistency, new/old sessions, UI and Studio continuity. Failed invariant triggers reviewed slice rollback.
acceptance: Explicit release/deployment receipts.
Old session valid; new cookie/metadata Hummingbird; new primary-agent writes apex.
Specialist/fallback provenance and memory safe; no history/token rewrite.
steps.rollback: Approved flag/config/unit rollback with active data preserved and source receipts retained.

steps.title: HB-19 Observe compatibility window and retire eligible aliases
steps.description: Measure legacy reader/client usage without secrets across the configured window. Retire only explicit approved aliases whose clients are migrated. Existing legacy sessions remain accepted to original natural expiry; externally needed aliases remain classified contracts.
acceptance: Configured TTL/client/version evidence, not an arbitrary date.
No remaining required old consumers before individual alias removal.
Operator per-alias retirement approval and regression tests.
steps.rollback: Restore removed reader alias only if its original trust/expiry policy remains intact.

steps.title: HB-20 Verify residual namespace ledger and final Studio closeout
steps.description: Rerun scoped inventory; every remaining legacy hit must be preserved history, third party, tested alias or explicit unresolved contract. Verify final evidence/rollback references through fresh-turn Studio readback. Operator signs off; deferred contracts prevent full completion.
acceptance: No unclassified active first-party legacy namespaces or legacy primary-agent writers.
Fresh-turn exact evidence retrieval and independent readback pass.
Operator closeout; unresolved platform/client contract leaves project partial/on hold.
steps.rollback: Reopen affected task with exact residual risk and receipts; never mark unresolved scope done.

teacher_payload.technical_awareness: This is an operator-requested review-only plan and Studio registration, not a rename implementation. Existing APEX is a fixed gpt-oss:20b local lane; specialist routing is a new feature with admission and external-service ownership requirements. Effective APEX tools lack an evidence-ID lookup. Studio project hold alone is not enforced by the inspected open-step selector, so register all tasks blocked. Preserve historical rows, active sessions, third-party names and dirty worktree. Exact future publisher application IDs and benchmarked model choices are not known; their tasks require explicit approval.

prerequisites: Goal: staged canonical Hummingbird framework and APEX agent migration with compatible legacy readers, immutable history and measured specialist routing.
Operator reviews Markdown/JSON and Studio on-hold project before releasing any task. Discover actual tools and task-specific approvals.
Use docs/HUMMINGBIRD_NAMESPACE_MIGRATION.md and its command/pattern catalogue; manifest steps HB-01 through HB-20 define sequence and acceptance.
procedure: Authorized SKILL Commands: none on normal APEX lane. Use attached structured read/proposal tools; Bash diagnostics/tests require a separately authorised bounded runner, not chat simulation.
Complete exact Studio evidence lookup, scheduler/approval gate verification and fresh-turn unseen tests before complex namespace work. Record every real attempt and correction.
Build classified source/contract ledger, preserve dirty baseline, prove isolated backup restoration and approve canonical alias map before changes.

Benchmark approved local orchestrator/coder candidates; implement host admission and gated llama-server coding handoff/Ollama fallback only through reviewed specialist proposals and existing approvals. One GPU coding lease, measured weights/KV/scratch and host RAM reserves, no assumed two-model fit.

Apply ordered reader-before-writer migration: identity/config, cookies/auth/SSE/approval, future storage/grants, rendered branding, module shims, deployment paths, separately approved signed platform contracts, active docs/CI.
Preserve old sessions to original expiry and historical rows unchanged. Canonical future primary-agent identity is apex, product namespace hummingbird; dependency/model names remain unchanged.

Require task-specific tests, source/model/approval receipts, memory peaks and independent Studio readback. Cut over and retire aliases only under explicit operator approval with rollback and observed consumer expiry.
capability_pack.failure_conditions: Stop on denied/unavailable tools, conflicting edits, missing or corrupt evidence, incomplete restore, identity/expiry violation, unknown memory/model provenance, exhausted budgets, unapproved service operation, failed required test or unavailable platform-upgrade verification. No global replacement, history rewrite, guessed package identity, forced process termination, silent backend switch, arbitrary SQL/shell or success from saved plans/prose.
